spans.s:
mfn. (-शन्-शती-शत्)
Inauspicious, (as discourse.)
E.
उव to burn, शतृ part. affix; also उषत्.

mfn. (-षन्-षती-षत्)
Inauspicious, (as discourse): see उशत्.

m. (-नाः)
A name of ŚUKRA, regent of the planet Venus.
E.
वस to wish, कनसि Uṇādi aff.

r. 1st cl. (ओषति)
To burn. (उ,) उषु (ओषति). To kill or injure: with प्र prefixed, this root makes प्रोषति, &c.

m. (-षः)
1 Early morning, dawn, day-break.
2 A libidinous man.
3

Bdellium.
4

Saline earth.
f. (-षा)
1 A cow.
2 Burning, scorching.
3 A proper name, the wife of

ANIRUDDHA.
4

Night.
5

A pot; also उखा.
ind.
The end of night or day-break.
E.
उष to burn, क affix and fem. do. टाप्; the affix of the particle is का.

r. 1st cl. (ऊषति)
To be diseased or disordered.

m. (-षः)
Salt ground, soil impregnated with saline particles.
n. (-षं)
Dawn, day-break.
f. (-षा)
The wife of ANIRUDDHA.
E.
ऊष to be or make sick, क affix, fem. टाप्: see उषा.

n. (-णं)
Black pepper.
f. (-णा)
1 Long pepper.
2 Chai, (Piper chavya.)
3 Dried ginger.
E.
उष to burn, कनच् aff.

n. (-णं)
Black pepper.
f. (-णा)
Long pepper: see उषण.

m. (-पः)
1 The sun.
2 Fire.
E.
उप to burn, पच् aff.

m. (-धः)
Fire.
E.
उषस् dawn, बुध to know, क aff.

n. (-षः)
1 The dawn, morning.
f. (-सी)
The end of the day. twilight.
E.
उष to burn, असि Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Belonging to the dawn.
E.
उषस् and य aff.

m. (-लः)
A cock.
E.
उषा dawn, कल to sound, अच् aff.

m. (-तिः)
A name of ANIRUDDHA, the son of KĀMADEVA.
E.
उषा and पति a lord, a master: the husband of UṢĀ.

m. (-णः)
ANIRUDDHA: see the preceding.
E.
उषा and रमण a husband, &c.

n. (-कं)
Dawn, day-break.
E.
as before, कन् added.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
A spot with saline soil.
E.
ऊस such soil, रच् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Consisting of saline soil, (a place, &c.)
E.
ऊष and poss. affix मतुप्.
